subject: Request: retro waiver & credit scheme for Neptune AI latency regression
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <dcho@neptuneai.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@neptuneai.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Significant latency increase impacting production — request for credit

Kimberly —

Thanks for taking this. Over the last two weeks we've observed a sharp increase in 95th/99th percentile token latency on the /v1/generate endpoint which has materially impacted our user experience (login flows, autosaves failing, and multi-step pipelines timing out). Our SREs isolated the window to 2026-11-05 through 2026-11-22 and traced behavior back to a change in the routing policy you shipped during the capacity reshuffle. We escalated to your engineering contacts but the stopgap workarounds only partially helped.

We appreciate Redwood's responsiveness, but per our contract SLOs we expect some form of remediation. Please advise what remediation or credit is available — we need an executive-level concession to present to our CFO.

Attaching a small sample of our traces and the OPS summary. Happy to jump on a call.

--
Daniel Cho
Director of Engineering, Neptune AI
dcho@neptuneai.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Significant latency increase impacting production — Neptune AI asks for executive concession

Folks — forwarding Neptune's escalation. They are asking for an executive-level concession tied to the 11/05–11/22 regression window. Customer is in contract (RDW-1429) and is sensitive to public-facing outages.

Quick asks:
- Hannah, can you prepare a recommended credit structure (numbers + cap) and a short note on the mitigations we performed?
- Rishi & Aditya: need guidance on whether we can offer a retroactive concession and the upper bound (dollars or % of invoice).
- Marissa: finance/legal routing — who signs the credit memo?

I think a time-boxed credit plus a service commitment for improved observability would be the clean path. Please reply with recommended language.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0198

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Significant latency increase impacting production — Neptune AI asks for executive concession

Team —

I reviewed Neptune's telemetry and our incident logs. Summary: the regression was caused by an aggressive traffic re-route to a new replica pool that had an incompatible kernel setting for long-sequence batches. We applied a rollback/config patch on 2026-11-20 which returned latencies to baseline; however, customer-facing impact persisted for a few days during cache warming.

Proposed concession (recommended, with rationale):
1) Retroactive invoice credit equal to 20% of their November 2026 consumption invoice (this maps to the approximate user minutes impacted; keeps alignment to contract SLO terms).
2) One free month of Dedicated capacity (for a single sandbox environment) to offset revalidation/QA costs.
3) A technical remediation package: 2 dedicated engineering hours for observability tuning + access to our private perf build for 30 days.

Estimated cap: $60,000 USD total (whichever is lower: calculated credit or cap). Attachments: incident timeline, calc sheet.

Language for customer: short, no admissions of negligence: we acknowledge that the service did not meet our expected latency profile for the window, we will issue a retroactive credit as above, and commit to the remediation items.

If leadership wants to be more conciliatory (larger credit or longer free months), I can adjust.

- Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Significant latency increase impacting production — Neptune AI asks for executive concession

Kim / Hannah —

Thanks for the clear write-up. Approve moving forward with Hannah's recommended package with a small modification: reduce the invoice credit to 15% and keep the one free month of Dedicated sandbox. The goal is to acknowledge impact while protecting margin and precedence. Approve up to a $50,000 USD cap.

Action items:
- Marissa, please prepare a one-time credit memo for 15% of the November invoice up to $50k and route to Neptune's accounts payable.
- Aditya, coordinate the CS/AM call with Neptune to present the credit and remediation plan; include the shared observability window and perf build access.
- Legal: no contract amendment required; handle acceptance via signed credit memo/DocuSign.

Once Marissa confirms the memo, Kim, you can send the exec-level note to the customer.

Rishi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <dcho@neptuneai.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:43:00 -0800
Subject: Executive concession approved — Neptune AI (RDW-1429)

Daniel —

Thank you again for raising this and for your patience while we assessed the window. On behalf of Redwood leadership, we have approved an executive concession to address the latency regression that affected you between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-22.

What we'll deliver:
- A one-time retroactive invoice credit equal to 15% of your November 2026 consumption invoice, capped at $50,000 USD.
- One free month of Dedicated sandbox capacity (applied to the Neptune test environment).
- A technical remediation package: 2 hours of engineering time for observability tuning and 30-day access to our private perf build.

Next steps: Marissa will send a credit memo and a DocuSign link for formal acceptance. Once signed, we'll apply the credit on your December invoice and schedule the remediation work.

We regret the disruption and are committed to preventing recurrence. If you'd like to review the incident and remediations in detail, Aditya and Hannah are available to join a technical debrief.

Best —
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
